setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the versions interesting, Dark Star in particular, despite the poor sound; Long, wrapping Dark Star with strong instrumental playing from the band [4][7]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer says this was the first time the band performed Sugaree [6]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Bird Song really nice [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-07-31.132730.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 205 min; rated 4.8/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: There are some skips in Casey Jones [1]
- **gd71-07-31.winberg.weiner.5678.gdADT05.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 175 min; rated 3.89/5 by 18 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience tape where crowd noise, including a screamer near the taper and constant clapping, drowns out the music; Recording has slightly off mid levels and very heavy crowd chatter; Crowd screams grate at first but calm down; the band members come through clearly for an audience tape [4][6][7][8][10][14]
- **gd1971-07-31.134686.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 204 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- The taper talks on the recording, including an introduction in which he asks what day it is [4]
- Would-be concertgoers stormed and flattened the fences, clashing with police [8]
- No shows, by the Dead or anyone else, were held at Yale Bowl after this one [8]
- Attendee recalls people trying to get through the fence and facing police and tear gas [9]
- Kopps Communication promoted the show well; many fans travelled from Long Island to attend [10]
- Attendee says the action outside the bowl amounted to a second show to watch [10]
- The taper explains what is happening after the show, unusual for audience tapes [15]
- Reviewer says this Dark Star rivals the 2/18 one and resembles the Halloween Dark Star and a July second Other One [7]
- At 21:20, this is the longest of four Dark Stars by the five-man lineup between 2-19 and 8-26 1971 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-07-31.132730.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> CD [1]
- **gd71-07-31.winberg.weiner.5678.gdADT05.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Marty Weinberg; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience [3]
- **gd1971-07-31.134686.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:132730)SBD -> Master Reel -> CD,CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC; Audience… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by www.deadlistening.com: [1971 July 31 - Yale Bowl](https://www.deadlistening.com/2008/02/1971-july-31-yale-bowl.html) [17]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Grateful Dead - Yale Bowl](https://www.dead.net/archives/1971/photos/grateful-dead-yale-bowl) [18]
